chunks: It was said to him (peace be upon him): We wish you had changed your grey hair, O’ Amīr al-mu’minīn.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say when asked to change his grey hair?
ai.summary: This narration from Nahj al-Balagha captures a moment where Imam Ali (AS) is advised to dye his grey hair, a practice common in pre-Islamic Arabia to conceal aging. His response, though brief here, is historically interpreted by Shia scholars as an acceptance of natural signs of aging as a form of humility and a reflection of the grief over the Prophet's death, rejecting vanity in favor of spiritual authenticity. This incident underscores the Shia emphasis on the Imam's adherence to the Sunnah and his unique status as the exemplar of balanced asceticism (zuhd).
